event_data.context: A full Codex-only behavior run on 2026-08-22 executed 411 compositions with zero provider errors but failed aggregate thresholds (106 passed, 305 failed). Across targeted/full plugin compositions, the only two fixtures that explicitly invoked `$development-system:development-workflow` passed 4/4, while implicitly routed fixtures passed 67/270. Both new protocol-attestation boundary cases passed in targeted and full plugin modes and failed in the no-plugin baseline as intended. This strongly indicates a central Codex skill-activation/eval-loader gap and subsumes the older single-case coordination regression. Do not weaken semantic rubrics or prime the no-plugin baseline. Claude-provider restoration is out of scope under the current user direction.
event_data.summary: Make Codex plugin compositions deterministically invoke each fixture's mapped development-system skills so provider evals measure the installed instructions instead of base-model improvisation.
event_data.title: Make Codex behavior evals invoke mapped development-system skills
